title: Lesson 30: Data Mapper Fundamentals & Source/Target Types
description: Define and configure Data Mappers to extract, transform, load and map data between source (JSON, XML, Custom Apex class, etc.) and target (JSON, XML, Custom Apex class, sObject, PDF, Docusign, etc.).

questions.question: Which Data Mapper interface is optimized for ONE object plus its related fields?
questions.explanation: Turbo Extract is optimized for single-object + related-field reads.

questions.question: Which targets can a Data Mapper produce?
options: JSON, XML, Apex class, sObject, PDF, Docusign
questions.explanation: Data Mappers target JSON, XML, Apex classes, sObjects, PDF, Docusign.
